what_happened: Compass pipeline.py on Mac Studio had adapters_v10_qwen as the default adapter path, but the directory was renamed to adapters_v1.0_qwen in git. The server auto-detect function (detect_adapter) was overriding the pipeline defaults and picking adapters_v9 because v9 sorts after v1.0 alphabetically. The user ran the compass thinking it was v1.0 but it was loading v9 + Ministral-3B instead of v1.0 + Qwen2.5-1.5B.
what_learned: When renaming directories in git, apply the rename on every machine that has a local copy — git pull only updates tracked files, it doesnt rename local directories unless the old name is tracked. Also: auto-detection that sorts alphabetically will pick v9 over v1.0 because 9 > 1 in string sort. Either use zero-padded version numbers (v01.0) or dont use auto-detection when hardcoded defaults are correct. The safest fix was removing the auto-detect override entirely and letting pipeline.py use its own defaults.
